name: Waaree Energies Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest solar-module maker by capacity (12 GW+ in India per Screener; 3.2 GW in Texas via Waaree Solar Americas), diversifying into cells, inverters (1.1 GW line live), BESS, T&D EPC, specialty gases and data centres. Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 7,518 cr (+24%), EBITDA Rs 1,335 cr (17.8% vs 23.2%), consolidated net profit Rs 719-753 cr (-14 to -15%). Revenue mix: retail 46%, utilities 23%, overseas 18.5%, EPC/O&M/T&D 12.6%. Order book fell 4% q/q after ~3 GW of US export orders were cancelled amid Section 232 uncertainty. FY27 EBITDA guidance Rs 7,000-7,700 cr reiterated (H1 Rs 2,775 cr: requires an H2 step-up). Stock at 52w low Rs 2,162 on 28 Oct, then +7%.

exposures.mechanism: Overseas is 18.5% of Q2 revenue (mostly US) at above-group margins. US Commerce final AD 123.04% + CVD 126.09% on Indian cells/modules (11 Sep 2026) and Section 232 minimum import prices ($0.22/W cells, $0.38/W modules, +15% polysilicon-derivative duty, effective 4 Dec 2026) plus 3 GW of cancelled US export orders. +10 pp further tariff -> marginal US volume -15% on ~15% of EBITDA -> EBITDA -2.5%; EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.8 (structural) -> -2.0. Largest US damage is already realised in the price (-35% from April high).

evidence.note: Final AD 123.04% and CVD 126.09% for Indian producers
Kotak: 3 GW export orders cancelled amid Section 232 uncertainty; order book -4% q/q
Section 232 MIPs and 15% duty effective 4 Dec; onshoring programme

exposures.mechanism: ALMM List-II (cells) and DCR rules shape the domestic premium market: retail/PM Surya Ghar (46% of Q2 revenue) and utility segments. +1 stronger support -> domestic volumes/prices +8%; revenue +8% with 35% flow-through -> +2.8% of revenue; EBITDA margin 18% -> +16%; EV/MCap 1.05; persistence 0.5 -> +8.4, trimmed for non-DCR weakness -> +6.

evidence.note: Retail 46% of revenue in Q2 (from 28.9% in Q1); utilities 22.9%
Kotak: weakness in non-DCR market behind profit miss

exposures.mechanism: Module-led, partly cell-integrated; EBITDA margin fell to 17.8% from 23.2% on price/mix. +10% realisation with ~40% flowing to margin = +4% of revenue; EBITDA +22%; EV/MCap 1.05; persistence 0.25 (cell capacity could reach 60-70 GW, per JM) -> +5.8, trimmed -> +5.

evidence.note: JM: gross margin 26%, EBITDA margin 17.8%; FY27 EBITDA guidance Rs 7,000-7,700 cr reiterated; industry cell capacity could reach 60-70 GW
EBITDA Rs 1,335 cr -5.1% y/y, margin 17.8% vs 23.2%

exposures.mechanism: Power demand growth drives RE tendering. +3 pp demand growth -> annual solar additions +5% -> volumes +5%; EBITDA +6%; x1.05 x 0.5 -> +3.2, trimmed -> +2.

evidence.note: India >50 GW dc solar additions forecast for 2026; slowdown after ALMM-II rush

exposures.mechanism: Silver paste ~4% of module COGS for in-house cells (cell capacity smaller than modules, so partial); +12% silver -> +0.5% COGS ~0.4% of revenue -> EBITDA -2.2% x 1.05 x 0.5 (pass-through half) -> -0.6; shrunk with empirical (silver not significant) -> -0.8.
Aluminium frames ~8% of module cost; +10% -> +0.8% COGS, 50% passed -> EBITDA -1.9%; x1.05 x 0.5 -> -0.9. Empirical +1.22 (t +0.7) is insignificant and opposite in sign; not adopted.

Import-heavy BOM (cells, wafers, glass, silver, EVA ~55% of COGS = ~41% of revenue) vs overseas revenue 18.5% and US module sales in USD; net short USD ~22% of revenue. +3% USD/INR -> -0.66% of revenue; half hedged/passed -> -0.33% -> EBITDA -1.8%; x1.05 x 0.5 -> -1.0; empirical -2.36 (t -1.0) -> -1.3.

Capex-heavy (US module lines, cells, inverters, BESS, data-centre arm) with interest Rs 105 cr in Q2 (up from Rs 43 cr a year earlier) and rising working capital; +25 bp on ~Rs 8,000 cr debt (estimate) = Rs 20 cr = 1% of PAT, plus customer financing costs -> -1.5.

Weaker yuan (+3% USD/CNY) cheapens Chinese cells/modules/wafers (Waaree imports cells and competes with Chinese-origin modules for non-DCR); landed cost advantage 3% on a 26% gross margin -> -1.0. Empirical -3.15 (t -0.7) is larger/insignificant.

New Indian duties on Chinese cells/glass shield module pricing but raise Waaree's import-cell cost; net ambiguous, slight positive as the group is expanding its own cell capacity. Status of current duties not re-verified (model knowledge).

evidence.note: DGTR solar cell/glass cases; not verified in this run

exposures.mechanism: Diversification into BESS, inverters (1.1 GW line live 30 Sep 2026), transformers/T&D EPC (Rs 600 cr new orders), data centres (Waaree Green Data Centers acquired). +1 = transition capex 10% above plan -> diversified revenue streams +6% -> EBITDA +5%; x1.05 x 0.6 -> +3.

evidence.note: Acquires Waaree Green Data Centers; expanding into batteries, transformers, transmission
Pack headline: commercial production on 1.10 GW inverter line in Gujarat
